inputs.rationale: Judged .8 households per matter excludes repeat and institutional matters; not health efficacy and not measured.

inputs.name: financialShare
inputs.unit: financially relevant household fraction
inputs.rationale: Judged half of modeled client households have a potentially material resource barrier; no local measured mix.

inputs.name: financialAdditionality
inputs.unit: additional resource-changing resolution fraction
inputs.rationale: Judged .25 additional implemented resource resolution versus existing protection and other advocates; independent of clinical success.

inputs.name: resourceGain
inputs.unit: USD net one-time change before health-overlap adjustment per financial resolution
inputs.rationale: Judged $1,500 net one-time resource change, after taxes, benefit withdrawal, displacement, replacement work and alternative assistance. Not gross awards or avoided face-value debt.

inputs.name: positiveOverlap
inputs.unit: retained fraction of positive resource benefit
inputs.rationale: Only positive resource change retained at .5 to avoid counting health-linked welfare twice; full negatives retained.

inputs.name: processCost
inputs.unit: USD full time/travel/work burden per exposed household
inputs.rationale: Judged $100 actual lost household time/travel/work resources, charged to all exposed households even no resolution or no clinical gain.

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.unit: USD annual household resources, one modeled welfareperson
inputs.rationale: Judged $20,000 household-year baseline; one welfareperson reference, family spillovers unpriced.

inputs.name: resourceYears
inputs.unit: finite household-year equivalent, not lifetime recurring salary
inputs.rationale: Central one-time gain and process burden occupy one finite household-year at delay1; two-year recurring-benefit scenario is a different hypothesis, not repeated lump collection.

inputs.name: resourceDelay

inputs.rationale: Finite conditional judgment, not a measured local causal effect; tested independently in serialized scenarios.

inputs.rationale: Unknown-neutral central0 is not observed absence of creditor or taxpayer loss; explicit .5 and1 matched transfer stress.

central.label: central

incomePathways.rationale: One welfareperson per distinct modeled client household, no unobserved family multiplier. Financial change and full legal-process burden net within the SAME household before log; only positive resources receive health-overlap adjustment.
incomePathways.counterfactual: Existing legal protections, alternative advocates, hospital case managers, benefits eligibility and grants continue. Gain is net of taxes, benefit withdrawal, replacement income and moving/work costs by judgment, not gross recovered debt or ordinary survivor earnings.
